description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class for handling product-related views in the SuiteCRM system. It includes licensing information, class definition for AOS_ProductsController extending SugarController, and an 'action_editview' method managing the edit view of products.

classes.name: AOS_ProductsController
classes.description: Controller class extending SugarController, handling the 'edit' view for products within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Handles the request for editing a product view, setting the view to 'edit', managing attachment deletion if indicated in the request, and cleaning output buffer.
